audit_result.proof_trace: The spec (SG-006 borrow diagram) mandates deducting borrow_fee = borrow_amount × fee_rate (0.3% main, 1% isolated/emerging) before returning funds, but handle_borrow (market.move:366-443) calls reserve::borrow_amount (reserve.move:196-201) which returns the exact requested amount with no deduction. The only use of repay_fee_rate in AssetConfig is as a reserve_factor in accrue_interest (market.move:1025), controlling what fraction of accrued interest goes to cash_reserve — a completely different mechanism. No borrow-fee deduction exists on any code path.
audit_result.attack_scenario: Any external caller invoking borrow() receives the full borrow_amount instead of borrow_amount*(1-fee_rate), bypassing the mandatory 0.3%/1% borrow fee entirely; the protocol loses all borrow fee revenue and INV-005 (fee deducted from loan amount) is never enforced.

PROP-01b-partial1-inv-033.text: Borrow fee must be 0.3% for main assets and 1% for isolated/emerging; fee must not be avoidable.
